name: deadbolt
description: Checks policy before forwarding tool calls to a trusted local stdio MCP server.
long_description: Bundles the published DeadBolt v1.0.3 engine with a host-side launcher. Configure your trusted downstream server, tool allow-list, irreversible-tool classification, destination tokens, reported-spend cap and local state paths in an operator-owned JSON file. Policy is applied before the downstream server starts. Operator approvals, pause and kill remain local CLI actions; they are not agent tools. DeadBolt gates routed tools/call requests. Startup, other MCP methods and arbitrary OS access are outside this boundary. The child server remains trusted. This bundle does not provide a sandbox or compliance certification. Mac ARM64/Intel, Linux x64 and Windows x64 binaries are included; Node.js 20+ is required. See README for setup and platform validation coverage.

operator_config.title: Operator configuration
operator_config.description: Absolute path to your private JSON file defining the trusted server, explicit tool policy and local state paths. Read the bundled README first.
